provenance.review_target: MKTCTX/3 packet containing a Continuum cross-section; exact packet artifact not identified

claims: No independent parser execution or complete hash-verification run was reported.
The reviewer reported that the selected Continuum material appeared coherent and intentional rather than a broad directory dump.

positive_findings: The guide, metadata, index, outlines, and exact chunks formed a useful layered separation of concerns.
Per-file hashes, manifest integrity, explicit projections, reasons, and chunk terminators made integrity and provenance first-class.
Global outlines and source ranges provided cheap structure before exact content.
Explicit omissions, absent task posture, lossless mode, and projection distinctions reduced downstream ambiguity.
The packet looked useful for cold starts, multi-agent handoffs, design and implementation loops, review, audit, onboarding, CI gates, multi-repository coordination, and model-context budgeting.
MKTCTX and Git bundles were judged complementary: Git bundles transfer repository object graphs, while MKTCTX presents an agent-oriented selected working set.
reviewer_characterization: A lossless, self-describing, agent-oriented context packet rather than a dump or archive.
A context object with cryptographic receipts.
A portable, verifiable working set for agents and humans who need high-fidelity understanding of a non-trivial system.
Exactness is the default; structure is the navigation layer; integrity is non-negotiable.
reviewer_priority: The reviewer prioritizes a stable packet-profile declaration, explicit selection reproducibility, and a cheaper companion view that points back to the lossless packet.

available_evidence: The complete review and proposed explainer were relayed by the user.
Two identical untracked copies of the supplied explainer already exist at docs/explain and docs/explain.md with SHA-256 1a36e81c3cb23662868d4171e6858558b05309f95aa45394424220838337ad9c.
limitations: The exact Continuum packet reviewed by Grok was not identified.
